title: nan
authors: Wang P.; Li J.; Wei J.; Shi L.; Hou B.; Xie F.
key_contribution: Presents a cooperative UAV swarm-mesh network with distributed EKF localization for GPS-denied disaster assessment, achieving sub-meter localization error though validated in simulation only.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
